question: The offical draw for FIFA U - 17 Women's World Cup India 2022 will be held in :
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zurich.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​According to **FIFA**, the draw for the **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup India 2022 **took place on **June 24 in Zurich.**
 
• It officially endorsed **Bhubaneswar, Goa, and Navi Mumbai** as the tournament's host cities.
 
• In addition to the hosts, India, six other nations—**Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Japan, and New Zealand** signed up for the competition.
 
• They were included in the **draw on June 24.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup India 2022:

 
 
• FIFA World Cup for Women Under-17 India 2022 marked the **seventh iteration** of the competition.
 
• It was** India's second time hosting **a FIFA event, following the **2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup** for men.
 
• Together with the host nation,** India, Morocco, and Tanzania** all made their tournament debuts.
 
• After winning their first** championship in 2018, Spain **was the defending champion.
